item.title: Burnham’s Britain can learn from Trump in engaging with China
item.description: Getting relations with China right is widely seen as Britain’s epoch-defining challenge. It is also one it is woefully unprepared to face. item.title: Gold Steadies as Conflicting Iran Signals Cloud Path for Rates
item.description: Gold held a decline as conflicting signals on efforts to end the Iran war clouded the outlook for inflation and the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.
